noPermission.title: Packing is not for your role
noPermission.body: Your role does not pack shipments at this station. Ask your team leader.

offline.held: Needs the network: the office records packing at once. Wait until it is back.

camera.error: The camera cannot read here: type the code.

list.hint: Or pick a shipment below. Only shipments of released garments are here.
list.title: Shipments to pack
list.notFound: {code} is no shipment of this station. Scan its pack slip again or ask the office.
list.serialFirst: {code} is a garment: open its shipment first (scan the pack slip).

empty.title: Nothing released to pack.
empty.body: The office plans a shipment once quality has released the garments.

released.batches: Released by quality: only released garments are on this shipment (batch {batches}).
released.plain: Released by quality: only released garments are on this shipment.

pack.alreadyPacked: This shipment is packed. Unpack it to change the cartons.
pack.hintNew: The first scan starts a new carton.

carton.noneLead: Scan a garment: a new carton starts by itself. Or start one with New carton.

rest.title: Put the rest in this carton
rest.serials_one: {cell}: {count} left. Scan each garment's serial label.
rest.serials_other: {cell}: {count} left. Scan each garment's serial label.

grid.title: Packed {packed} of {garments}
grid.caption: Garments per style, colour and size: packed of planned

left.title: Still to do
left.noLines: No garments on this shipment: the office adds them.
left.none: Everything is in weighed cartons: packing is done.

refused.notReleased: Not released by quality yet: it stays out of the carton.
refused.notThisShipment: Not on this shipment: put it aside and tell the office.
refused.void: This serial is void: put the garment aside and tell the team leader.
refused.noRoom: No more of this size on this shipment: an extra piece. Put it aside.
refused.serialTracked: {cell} is traced by serial: scan each garment's serial label.
refused.batchDone: Every garment of this batch is in a carton already.
refused.unknown: Not on this shipment: check the label.
refused.notDraft: This shipment is packed: unpack it first to change the cartons.
refused.offline: Needs the network: scan it again when the network is back.

documents.title: DDT and packing list
documents.readyBoth: The DDT and the packing list print on the station's printer.
documents.readyDdt: The DDT prints on the station's printer.
documents.noPreview: The documents are read in the office; the tablet prints them.

held.officeIssues: The office issues the DDT: it shows here as soon as it is issued.
held.pdfMissing: The DDT's PDF is not stored yet: the office prints it again.
held.noPrinter: No document printer at this station: the office prints the DDT.
held.nothing: Nothing to print yet: the office issues the DDT and buys the labels.

held.officeBuys: The office buys the labels: they show here once bought.
held.noPrinter: No label printer at this station: the office prints the labels as PDF.
held.noRight: Your role does not print labels here.

notNeeded.SENDER: No carrier label: the goods go in our own van.
notNeeded.RECIPIENT: No carrier label: the customer collects the goods.

jobs.title: Print jobs
jobs.label: Label · carton {seq}
jobs.retryLabel: Print the label of carton {seq} again

held.labelled: A carton has a carrier label: the office voids it first.
held.ddt: The DDT is issued: the office cancels it first.
